name: Music-driven visual essay

look.grade: one colour world per section; B&W only as a device (sections with colour on the drop, one colour kept)

type_voice: a serif or condensed display face; lines set as lockups on the cut

structure.what: a still that drifts in 2.5D, one line of type
archival and sourced B-roll on the phrase, cuts on the user's track beats
the montage on 8ths, depth and time devices on the hits
a held frame, the last line

never: picking the music (the user's track only)
more than 3 full-frame flashes per second without the user's opt-in
notes: Every section gets its own idea; the essay never repeats a device on consecutive shots.
